goal: 按 id 升序列出所有订单的编号。
sql: SELEC id FROM orders ORDER BY id

goal: 按订单 id 升序列出每笔订单的商品数量，不是订单金额。
sql: SELECT amount FROM orders ORDER BY id

goal: 按 id 升序列出尚未归还的借阅编号。
sql: SELECT id FROM loans WHERE returned_on = NULL ORDER BY id

goal: 按客户 id 升序列出所有客户 id 和他们的已支付订单数，包括没有已支付订单的客户。
sql: SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

goal: 按 id 升序列出计算机类别的图书编号。
sql: SELECT id FROM books WHERE category = '计算机' ORDER BY id
